name: Elf Tsuma to Love Icha Omedeta Seikatsu ~Koi Milk Nonde Nomarete Mou Hitori Tsukurimasho♪~
original_name: エルフ妻とラブイチャおめでた生活～濃いミルク飲んで飲まれてもう一人作りましょ♪～
source:
Keita is just a white-collar worker. One day, he meets a beautiful girl, Elena, in the mountain and finds that she has long ears. Elena is gradually attracted to Keita, who doesn't get surprised even when he knows she is half human beings and half elf. Like this, they get married.... They live a happy life, but he accidentally knows a secret of Elena.... A forbidden love between Elf and human beings. But they decide to live together for their baby....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
庆太只是一名普通白领。一天，他在山中遇见美丽少女艾蕾娜，并发现她长着一双尖尖的长耳朵。即使得知艾蕾娜是人类与精灵的混血，庆太也没有感到惊讶，这让她渐渐被他吸引。就这样，两人结为夫妻…婚后生活幸福美满，庆太却偶然发现了艾蕾娜的一个秘密…这是一段精灵与人类之间的禁忌之恋，但为了两人的孩子，他们决定继续相守…

[摘自ErogeShop]
